title: Accepted Actual-Transpiration Attribution Contract

accepted_actual_transpiration.unit_semantics: integrated water amount over the committed candidate interval
accepted_actual_transpiration.source_of_rate: the exact solver forcing used to produce the committed candidate, not a separately recomputed process value
accepted_actual_transpiration.reconciliation: the attributed amount is a named subset of already-booked accepted total_out and must never be added to total_out again

rollback_and_retry.reason: qrot is immutable over the outer interval and no candidate exists unless the full outer interval completes

inputs: the exact fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t used for the candidate
recommended_implementation_seam.output: typed accepted root-water-uptake/transpiration attribution receipt with lineage, revision, [t0,t1] and integrated amount

nonclaims: dynamic root-sink reevaluation inside one outer interval
oxygen, salinity, frost, compensation, MICRO, Jong-van-Lier or macropore uptake
general process-attribution framework for every flux family
